channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: antigravity.google: Google Antigravity Agentic Platform
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides a dedicated cloud-native development platform and SDK to build, evaluate, and deploy stateful AI agents directly to GKE.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crossplane transforms Kubernetes into a universal cloud control plane, fundamentally shifting how platform teams manage multi-cloud infrastructure declaratively.

item.title: NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin: NVIDIA device plugin for Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] The NVIDIA device plugin serves as the foundational integration layer enabling GPU hardware acceleration for modern AI/ML workloads across Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: buildkit
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational next-generation build engine driving high-performance, concurrent, and cache-efficient container image builds across the ecosystem.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Istio remains the industry-benchmark enterprise service mesh, driving zero-trust security and the paradigm shift toward sidecarless ambient mesh architectures.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 is a foundational CNCF-graduated project that pioneered the GitOps Toolkit architecture for decoupled Kubernetes configuration reconciliation.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational CNCF benchmark time-series engine that powers metrics scraping and alerting across cloud-native environments.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the industry-standard, CNCF-graduated container runtime powering Kubernetes nodes across production cloud-native environments.

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kueue: Kubernetes-native Job Queueing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kueue establishes the standard cloud-native job queueing architecture required to manage multi-tenant AI, ML, and batch workloads efficiently on Kubernetes.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] HashiCorp Vault remains the cornerstone enterprise solution for secrets management, dynamic credential issuance, and Zero Trust architecture.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the ubiquitous, vendor-agnostic data pipeline engine underpinning modern cloud-native telemetry collection and routing.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the industry-standard cloud native utility for orchestrating backup, disaster recovery, and volume migration in Kubernetes.

item.title: New in Terraform 1.15: Dynamic sources, variable deprecation, and more
item.description: [CRITICAL] Terraform 1.15 introduces native dynamic module sources, resolving a long-standing architectural constraint in enterprise infrastructure code reusability.

item.title: Falco.org
item.description: [CRITICAL] Falco is the CNCF-graduated standard for cloud-native runtime security and real-time threat detection using eBPF and kernel syscall monitoring.

item.title: Argo CD
item.description: [CRITICAL] Argo CD represents the definitive industry standard for declarative, GitOps-based continuous delivery across enterprise Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: crossplane.io
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crossplane leads the cloud-native infrastructure shift by turning Kubernetes into a universal, declarative control plane across multi-cloud environments.

item.title: podman
item.description: [CRITICAL] It leads the enterprise shift toward daemonless, rootless container execution, significantly improving host security and operational simplicity.

item.title: gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] The Gateway API is the official next-generation Kubernetes standard superseding Ingress with role-oriented, expressive traffic management across service meshes and ingress controllers.

item.title: Apache Kafka
item.description: [CRITICAL] It remains the de facto distributed event streaming foundation across enterprise cloud native architectures.

item.title: min.io
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the leading high-performance, S3-compatible object storage layer tailored specifically for Kubernetes deployments.
